reason: Nobody has written a rule or brought an enforcement case on AI agents trading customer accounts yet, so I'm not putting a new vendor in my order path for next year's budget on the back of FINRA reports and speeches. Shadow mode is a cheap way to look, but it still means a pre-SOC 2 startup with zero customers going through my vendor review.
objection: Another hop in front of the MCP server is latency and a new point of failure, even in pass-through mode, and I'd be trusting a company with no customers and no SOC 2 report to sit in the path. Mapping controls to 'expectations' doesn't help me when the expectations aren't written rules.
would_change_my_mind: FINRA issuing an actual rule or bringing an enforcement action over agent-initiated trading without supervisory controls, with a finished SOC 2 Type II behind the vendor.
